note: The French Southern and Antarctic Lands have no permanent population: those there are French state staff, scientists and contractors, under the authorisation of the TAAF's prefect. Majority and work: France's civil code (majority at 18, art. 414) and labour code apply in the TAAF only where a text extends them (the TAAF's statute, loi n° 55-1052 of 6 August 1955, with legislative speciality); that text couldn't be read (Légifrance refuses this client), so both are null. Service: France's military service was suspended in 1996 (the Ministry of the Armed Forces' press kit on the new service national, read 2026-10-31: the new service, ten months for volunteers of 18 to 25 from 2026, has no compulsory character), so service is none; the citizen census at 16 and the defence and citizenship day (JDC, renamed the journée de mobilisation) remain duties of every young French national, which the form doesn't hold.

sources.title: Ministère des Armées: Dossier de presse, Service national (defense.gouv.fr)
sources.said: Contrairement à l’ancien service suspendu en 1996, il n’a aucun caractère obligatoire. ... Le service national s’adresse aux jeunes Françaises et Français volontaires âgés de 18 à 25 ... Durée du service : 10 mois, dont un mois de formation militaire initiale.
